0.title: AI-powered journaling guidance
0.description: Keeping an automatic thought journal can sometimes be challenging. Our recommendation system is here to help—offering guidance and support to help you navigate your thoughts more clearly and comfortably.

1.title: Personalized analysis of your entries
1.description: Share your experiences with our AI to gain a fresh perspective. The AI provides supportive recommendations and identifies cognitive distortions, helping you work through them more effectively.

2.title: Data privacy and security
2.description: You can set a password to enter the app, and your data is additionally encrypted. This provides a high level of protection and ensures that only you have access to your entries.

3.title: AI-powered speech recognition
3.description: We use advanced speech recognition technology with emotion analysis. The app automatically adds punctuation and structures your text to keep it neat, allowing you to create entries much faster than typing manually.

4.title: Sync across all devices
4.description: Your entries are securely encrypted and stored on our server. This allows you to use your journal on different devices and access your data anytime, anywhere.

5.title: Full access to tests
5.description: Our tests are developed with professional psychologists and include clear explanations. They will help you understand yourself better and track changes in your mental well-being over time.

6.title: Unlimited access to the knowledge base
6.description: We have built an extensive knowledge base on mental well-being and are constantly expanding it. Read unlimited articles and discover new ways to practice self-care every day.

7.title: Add images to your entries
7.description: Add images to your entries to convey emotions and context more accurately. All photos will be synced across your devices and, if needed, can be shared with your psychologist.

texts: A 3-day trial period is provided for 3-month and 12-month subscriptions. Once the trial ends, the amount corresponding to your chosen plan will be charged automatically.
By making your first subscription payment, you agree to subsequent automatic charges according to your chosen plan until the subscription is canceled.
You can cancel your subscription at any time on this page. If you cancel before the trial period ends, you will not be charged.
If you cancel your subscription renewal before the end of the trial period, access to Premium features will end immediately.
If you cancel your subscription after a payment has been processed, you will retain access to Premium features until the end of the paid period.
Refunds for 1, 3, or 12-month subscriptions are only possible in the following cases:
1. The charge was due to a technical error on our part.
2. The payment was made fraudulently without your consent.
In all other cases, refunds for 1, 3, or 12-month subscriptions are not provided after the trial period ends.
If you encounter any issues, you can always reach out to us via the feedback form on the "Profile" page.
